DLC2313:4:t_030:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I've seen more than enough of your fighting spirit.」

DLC2313:4:t_031:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I don't need to worry about you anymore, right?」

DLC2313:4:t_031:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「...$$シンジ$$. Once you've worked your body until your mind goes blank, then...」

DLC2313:4:t_031:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「Eat until you're full and get some sleep!」

DLC2313:4:t_100:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Like hell we'll lose! Neither this world nor I are so cheap that we'll dance to a brat's tune!」

DLC2313:4:t_100:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$ミカゲ$$, $$バルビエル$$! We'll smash your selfish whims to pieces!」

DLC2313:4:t_101:0.en:
$$號$$
（No one has lost hope or the will to fight.）

DLC2313:4:t_101:1.en:
$$號$$
（We can fight. No matter how powerful the enemy...!）

DLC2313:4:t_102:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go! We'll open a path for $$シンジ$$ and $$アマタ$$!」

DLC2313:4:t_102:1.en:
$$いぶき$$
「You're more fired up than usual, $$赤木$$.」

DLC2313:4:t_102:2.en:
$$青山$$
「It seems setting an example for $$シンジ$$ and the others is doing him some good, too.」

DLC2313:4:t_102:3.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Maybe $$赤木$$ has a surprising knack for leadership.」

DLC2313:4:t_102:4.en:
$$青山$$
「Well... We're not exactly likely to get any new recruits.」

DLC2313:4:t_102:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's enough chatter! The enemy's right in front of us!」

DLC2313:4:t_102:7.en:
$$いぶき$$
「We have to show these boys what grown-ups can do!」

DLC2313:4:t_103:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
（Everyone is lending me their strength...）

DLC2313:4:t_103:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
（Not just the other $$エレメント$$s. $$竜馬$$ and $$赤木$$, too...）

DLC2313:4:t_103:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
（And I have $$ミコノ$$! That's why... I can fight!!）

DLC2313:4:t_104:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
（Move my feet forward, even if it's only one step at a time...）

DLC2313:4:t_104:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
（If I do that, will I... get there someday...?）

DLC2313:4:t_104:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
（But... where... am I supposed to go...?）

DLC2313:4:t_105:0.en:
$$アスカ$$
（Ha... To think a salaryman's words would sink in so easily... I guess I've grown up, too...）

DLC2313:4:t_105:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
（Looking back won't turn back time... Then all I can do is struggle with everything I've got!）

DLC2313:4:t_106:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well, then... It's been stressful lately. Let's work it off with a little exercise.」

DLC2313:4:t_106:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「I know we just tore that selfish $$堕天翅$$'s argument apart, but you lot can still be our punching bags!」

DLC2313:4:t_107:1.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
（Am I a child... or an adult...?）

review.context: The training ends with practical advice to eat and rest; combat reflections show each pilot's different stage of emotional recovery.
decisions: Gou's will to fight is ordinary resolve here, not the Fury Spirit command.
Rei's self-questioning remains existential, without assigning her a conclusion absent from the source.
